<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 480" width="600" height="480">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="600" height="480" fill="#fff"/>

  <!-- axes with arrowheads -->
  <line x1="60" y1="400" x2="60" y2="62" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polygon points="55,64 60,50 65,64" fill="#000"/>
  <line x1="60" y1="400" x2="558" y2="400" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polygon points="558,395 570,400 558,405" fill="#000"/>
  <text x="72" y="48" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#000">Number of molecules</text>
  <text x="570" y="428" text-anchor="end" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#000">Energy</text>

  <!-- T1 distribution (solid) -->
  <path d="M60,400 L72,370.5 Q84,341 96,293 Q108,245 120,207.5 Q132,170 144,150 Q156,130 168,126 Q180,122 192,129 Q204,136 228,166 Q252,196 276,229 Q300,262 324,287.5 Q348,313 372,331 Q396,349 420,360 Q444,371 468,377.5 Q492,384 516,387.5 L540,391" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- T2 distribution (dashed) -->
  <path d="M60,400 L72,387 Q84,374 96,349 Q108,324 120,299.5 Q132,275 144,256.5 Q156,238 168,226.5 Q180,215 192,210 Q204,205 216,205.5 Q228,206 240,210 Q252,214 276,229.5 Q300,245 324,262.5 Q348,280 372,296.5 Q396,313 420,326 Q444,339 468,349 Q492,359 516,366 L540,373" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="8 5"/>

  <!-- curve labels -->
  <text x="176" y="108" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Times New Roman, Times, serif" font-size="17" font-style="italic" fill="#000">T<tspan font-size="12" font-style="normal" dy="4">1</tspan></text>
  <text x="362" y="262" font-family="Times New Roman, Times, serif" font-size="17" font-style="italic" fill="#000">T<tspan font-size="12" font-style="normal" dy="4">2</tspan></text>

  <!-- caption -->
  <text x="300" y="460" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#000">Fig. 5.1</text>
</svg>
